factor_base.construction: kernel of the linearised polynomial of irreducible factor 0 of x^n - 1 over F2 (legacy degree-ord_n(2) family); every point with abscissa in that subspace
factor_base.quotient_rule: signed Frobenius orbits merged by cofactor projection

field.element_encoding: integer whose bit i is the coefficient of z^i, 0x lowercase hex

point_decomposition.internal_matrix_kernel: f4_gf2: rank-indexed build over the occurring variables with caps in reference units, leading-column bucketed echelon over degree>=2 columns, linear-block RREF; F5 and Boolean field-equation row pruning
point_decomposition.solver: matrix-F4 at degrees max(2,deg)..3 with DPLL splitting on the lowest free variable, node budget 4096, stop at the first root that lifts
point_decomposition.weil_descent: x_i = sum_t v_(i,t) b_t over the subspace basis; one Boolean equation per polynomial-basis coordinate of S3

relation_collection.dependencies: incremental echelon over Z/rZ; dependent rows counted
relation_collection.filter: lift every root to points and re-add them in the group
relation_collection.queries: R = [a]G + [b]Q with a, b uniform in [1, r) from StdRng
relation_collection.stop: as soon as the recovered scalar verifies [d]G = Q

relation_linear_algebra.implementation: IncrementalRelationSolver, dense reduced echelon over Z/rZ
relation_linear_algebra.rows: relations over the effective columns plus the target column

target_descent: direct: every relation carries the target; d is read off the relation matrix and checked as [d]G = Q
